intake_context.source_note: The traveller typed the full brief into the conversation instead of the form: family of 4 (2 adults, children aged 7 and 10) living in London, UK residents, 17-20 October 2026, train to Edinburgh, rental car, 2 nights Pitlochry then 1 night St Andrews, children can walk about 30 minutes at a stretch, no allergies.

trip.title: Pitlochry and St Andrews by train and car
trip.pace: Relaxed family pace: two or three stops a day, no walk longer than 30 minutes
trip.budget_basis: Per person in GBP: rail, car hire, fuel and parking, rooms, food and Blair Castle; excludes travel insurance and spending money.

mobility_notes: Children aged 7 and 10: keep any single walk to about 30 minutes.

payment.not_applicable_reason: UK residents paying in pounds with their own UK cards; nothing changes in Scotland apart from Scottish banknotes, which are legal currency throughout the UK.

connectivity.not_applicable_reason: Their own UK phones and UK plugs work as at home; download the map offline because signal drops on the B8019 by Queen's View.

emergency.summary: Dial 999 or 112 for police, ambulance, fire and mountain rescue; NHS 24 on 111 for urgent advice that is not an emergency.

health_and_insurance.not_applicable_reason: UK residents are covered by the NHS in Scotland exactly as at home; no travel insurance is needed for care.

regional_service_context.selection_basis: UK residents at home: Google Maps, National Rail retailers and UK car-hire sites all work normally.
regional_service_context.booking_platform_selection_note: Trainline shows LNER and Lumo side by side with railcard discounts; Booking.com covers all four hotels with family-room filters; car hire is quoted on the operators' own sites because both have desks at Waverley.

booking_access_checks.requirements_note: E-tickets on a phone; a Family & Friends Railcard must be carried on board.

booking_access_checks.provider_or_channel: Booking.com and the hotels' own sites
booking_access_checks.requirements_note: Card guarantee at booking; no local phone needed.
Full UK licence, a DVLA check code generated within 21 days, and a credit card in the main driver's name for the deposit.

booking_access_checks.provider_or_channel: Blair Castle website or admissions desk
booking_access_checks.requirements_note: No account needed; tickets also sold at the door.

breakdown.description: Fuel for about 334 km, four car parks, St Andrews overnight parking; no tolls

breakdown.description: Two nights in Pitlochry and one in St Andrews, one family room, breakfast included
breakdown.note: Room totals GBP 470-770 divided by four.

Child GBP 13, adult GBP 19; everything else is free.

return_itinerary.connection_or_terminal_note: Direct; calls at Newcastle and York.

ground_transport.material_conditions: Advance fares are train-specific and non-refundable but changeable for a fee; seat reservations are included. A Family & Friends Railcard takes a third off adult fares and 60% off child fares.
ground_transport.seat_reservation: Included; ask for a table of four
ground_transport.station_transfer_note: The Hertz desk is at the New Street car park by Waverley, a 5-minute walk; no taxi needed.

outbound_itinerary.connection_or_terminal_note: Direct; calls at Stevenage, Newcastle and Morpeth.

return_itinerary.connection_or_terminal_note: Direct; calls at Morpeth, Newcastle and Stevenage.

ground_transport.material_conditions: Standard class only; each fare includes a reserved seat, one large and one small bag per person. Fares are refundable for a fee up to the day before.
ground_transport.station_transfer_note: Arrives 18 minutes earlier than LNER at the same station; the Hertz desk is a 5-minute walk.

attraction_tickets.timed_entry_or_reservation: No timed entry; buy online or at the admissions desk. Castle open daily 09:30-17:30 until the end of October, last entry 16:30.

sale_opens_at.basis: Blair Castle's visitor page sells day tickets online and at the desk with no timed slots in the October season.

rental_cars.pickup_location: Hertz, Edinburgh Waverley Station (New Street car park)
rental_cars.dropoff_location: Hertz, Edinburgh Waverley Station (New Street car park)
rental_cars.vehicle_class: Intermediate estate (Skoda Octavia Estate or similar)
rental_cars.transmission: Manual; automatic about GBP 10-15 a day more
rental_cars.capacity_note: 5 seats and a boot for 2 large cases plus 2 small bags; two high-back booster seats requested (UK law: under 12 or under 135 cm)
rental_cars.insurance_excess: Basic cover carries an excess of about GBP 1,000-1,500; the excess waiver costs extra
rental_cars.cross_border_or_restriction_note: Ferries to the islands or Northern Ireland need Hertz's written consent; the main driver needs a full UK licence held for a year and a DVLA check code.

rental_cars.vehicle_class: Compact estate (Ford Focus Estate or similar)
rental_cars.capacity_note: 5 seats; 2 large cases plus 1 small bag; booster seats bookable at the desk
rental_cars.insurance_excess: Excess about GBP 1,200 on basic cover
rental_cars.cross_border_or_restriction_note: No ferry crossings without prior agreement; drivers aged 23+ with a full licence.

notes: Train both ways between London and Edinburgh; the car is collected and returned at Waverley, so there is no driving in London or central Edinburgh.
Drive on the left. No tolls anywhere on the route: the Queensferry Crossing, the M90 and the A9 are all free.
The A9 between Perth and Pitlochry has average-speed cameras; stick to the limit throughout.
Children under 12 or under 135 cm must ride in a booster seat; both hire cards include two.
Check Traffic Scotland before each drive in October for A9 roadworks.
transport_overview.headline: Train to Edinburgh, then a hire-car loop through Pitlochry, Dunkeld and St Andrews

days.title: Train to Edinburgh, collect the car, drive to Pitlochry
days.focus: Get the four of you from King's Cross to Pitlochry with one proper lunch and the car collected at Waverley.

activities.name: LNER train London King's Cross to Edinburgh Waverley
activities.detail: Arrives 12:23. Book a table of four in coach seats; the rail card below compares LNER and Lumo.

activities.name: Collect the hire car at Hertz, Edinburgh Waverley
activities.detail: Allow 30 minutes for paperwork and fitting two booster seats.

activities.name: Drive to Pitlochry
activities.detail: About 95 minutes via the Queensferry Crossing, M90 and A9.

activities.name: Check in at Atholl Palace Hotel
activities.detail: Family room for two nights; the grounds have a play area.

dining.why_this_stop: Three minutes from the platform, so lunch happens before the car is collected rather than on the A9.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Book for 12:45 on a Saturday; a children's menu is available.
dining.backup_note: Switch if Howies cannot seat four; Café Royal serves food from 12:00 and is two minutes closer to the station.

dining.why_this_stop: A 16-minute walk from the hotel along a lit pavement, and a family pub with a children's menu.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Walk-ins usually seated before 18:30; book on a Saturday in October.
dining.backup_note: Use it if the Old Mill has no table; Victoria's is on Atholl Road on the way back.

route.route_logic: Lunch next to the station first, so the car is collected on full stomachs and the 95-minute drive needs no stop.
route.fallback_plan: If the train runs late past 13:30, skip Howies and eat at the station, then collect the car; Hertz holds a booking for a delayed train when the train number is on it.
route.walking_burden: 46 min on foot between stops (3.3 km of walking legs) plus 25 min on foot at stops, 71 min in total; the longest single walk is 16 min.
route.fare_basis_or_fuel_toll_parking_note: Fuel for the car, not per person. No tolls anywhere on this route. Hotel parking is free.
route.service_or_driving_caveat: Saturday traffic on the A90 out of Edinburgh can add 15 minutes. The A9 has average-speed cameras between Perth and Pitlochry.

segments.journey_instruction: Leave Waverley by the Waverley Steps exit onto Princes Street, turn right and cross at the lights onto Waterloo Place.
segments.arrival_instruction: Howies is on the left, a few doors past the Balmoral end of Waterloo Place.
segments.fallback_note: If the Steps are closed, use the Market Street exit and the lift up to Princes Street.

segments.journey_instruction: Walk back down to the station and follow the signs for the New Street car park and car hire.
segments.arrival_instruction: The Hertz desk is at the car park entrance on the station's east side.
segments.fallback_note: If the desk has moved, the booking confirmation gives the current counter; phone Hertz before walking out of the station.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: A90, Queensferry Crossing, M90, A9 north
segments.journey_instruction: Leave the city by the A90 to the Queensferry Crossing, take the M90 to Perth and the A9 north; turn off at the second Pitlochry junction.
segments.arrival_instruction: The hotel drive is on the right at the south end of Atholl Road; free parking for guests.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel for this leg, per car, about 118 km at hire-car consumption; no tolls on the Queensferry Crossing or the M90.
segments.fallback_note: If the A9 is closed north of Perth, the A822 through Crieff and Aberfeldy adds about 30 minutes.

segments.journey_instruction: Walk down the hotel drive and along Atholl Road into the town centre, then turn up Mill Lane.
segments.arrival_instruction: The Old Mill Inn is the stone mill with the water wheel at the top of Mill Lane.
segments.fallback_note: In heavy rain, drive: there is a pay car park behind the main street.

segments.journey_instruction: Back down Mill Lane and left along Atholl Road; the pavement is lit all the way.
segments.arrival_instruction: The hotel drive climbs gently on the left.
segments.fallback_note: A taxi from the town centre takes five minutes if the children are tired.

days.contingency: If the morning train is cancelled, the next LNER service is 30 minutes later; phone Hertz to move the pickup time rather than rebooking.

days.title: Blair Castle, Queen's View and Pitlochry Dam
days.focus: A castle morning and two short scenic stops, with every walk kept under half an hour.

activities.name: Drive to Blair Castle
activities.detail: 15 minutes north on the A9.

activities.name: Blair Castle state rooms
activities.detail: Timed to the 09:30 opening crowd having thinned; the ticket card has prices.

activities.name: Sit-down snack in the castle courtyard
activities.detail: A seated break between the rooms and the garden.

activities.name: Hercules Garden loop
activities.detail: The walled garden and its pond, a flat 25-minute loop.

activities.name: Drive to Queen's View
activities.detail: 20 minutes on the B8019.

activities.name: Queen's View over Loch Tummel
activities.detail: Paved path from the car park; 15 minutes on foot.

activities.name: Pitlochry Dam and fish ladder
activities.detail: Visitor centre and the salmon ladder; walk across the dam and back.

activities.name: Back at the hotel
activities.detail: Rest before dinner.

dining.why_this_stop: Two minutes from the castle, so the car does not leave the village before lunch.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Walk-in bar lunch; Sunday lunch fills from 12:30, so arrive by 12:15.
dining.backup_note: Switch if the bar is full; the House of Bruar is five minutes west on the A9 and serves until 17:00.

dining.cuisine_or_style: Highland pub with its own brewery
dining.why_this_stop: A six-minute drive up the hill and the best-reviewed pub near the hotel; families are seated in the lounge.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Book for Sunday evening; walk-ins wait up to 30 minutes after 18:30.
dining.backup_note: Use the Old Mill in Pitlochry if Moulin has no table; it serves food until 21:00.

route.route_logic: Blair Castle opens first and is the longest visit, so it gets the fresh morning; Queen's View and the dam sit on the drive home.
route.fallback_plan: In heavy rain keep Blair Castle, which is mostly indoors, and swap Queen's View for the Pitlochry Dam visitor centre's indoor exhibition.
route.walking_burden: 8 min on foot between stops (every leg is driven) plus 95 min on foot at stops, 103 min in total, in blocks of 30 min or less.
route.fare_basis_or_fuel_toll_parking_note: Fuel for the car plus one GBP 3 car park at Queen's View. No tolls.
route.service_or_driving_caveat: The B8019 along Loch Tummel is a narrow two-lane road with passing traffic on bends; allow the full 20 minutes.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: A9 north, B8079 into Blair Atholl
segments.journey_instruction: North on the A9 for 10 km, leave at Blair Atholl and follow the castle signs up the avenue.
segments.arrival_instruction: Park in the castle car park; the entrance is a three-minute walk.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel only; parking is free for ticket holders.
segments.fallback_note: If the A9 slip road is shut, the B8079 through Killiecrankie reaches the same village.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: castle avenue to the village
segments.journey_instruction: Down the castle avenue and left into the village.
segments.arrival_instruction: The Atholl Arms is opposite the railway station; park on its forecourt.
segments.fallback_note: Walking the avenue takes 15 minutes if the car park is full.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: B8079 to Garry Bridge, then B8019 west
segments.journey_instruction: South through Killiecrankie, cross the Garry Bridge and follow the B8019 along Loch Tummel.
segments.arrival_instruction: Queen's View car park is on the left; the viewpoint is a short paved path from the visitor centre.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel plus the Forestry and Land Scotland car park charge of about GBP 3.
segments.fallback_note: If the car park is full, the Allean Forest car park 3 km further west has a woodland path.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: B8019 east, B8079 south into Pitlochry
segments.journey_instruction: Back east on the B8019, over the Garry Bridge, then south into Pitlochry and follow the dam signs.
segments.arrival_instruction: The visitor centre car park is above the dam; the fish ladder is next to it.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel only; the visitor centre car park is free.
segments.fallback_note: If the visitor centre is shut, the dam walkway and fish ladder are still open to walk.
segments.detour_reason: No road crosses Loch Faskally between Queen's View and the dam; the only road bridge is the Garry Bridge upstream, so the drive runs round the loch.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: through Pitlochry to the hotel
segments.journey_instruction: Through the town centre and east along Atholl Road.
segments.arrival_instruction: Hotel car park.
segments.fallback_note: The same short drive via Knockfarrie Road if the main street is busy.

segments.journey_instruction: Up Moulin Road from the town centre; the village is 2 km uphill.
segments.arrival_instruction: The inn's car park is behind the building.
segments.fallback_note: A taxi from Pitlochry takes five minutes if the driver wants a drink.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: Moulin Road back down
segments.journey_instruction: Back down Moulin Road and along Atholl Road.
segments.arrival_instruction: Hotel car park.
segments.fallback_note: Taxi as above.

days.contingency: If Blair Castle closes early for an event, spend the morning at the Pitlochry Dam visitor centre and see the castle grounds only.

days.title: Via Dunkeld to St Andrews
days.focus: Break the drive at a waterfall and a ruined cathedral, then reach the sea by mid-afternoon.

activities.name: Check out of Atholl Palace Hotel
activities.detail: Load the car.

activities.name: Drive to The Hermitage
activities.detail: 22 minutes south on the A9.

activities.name: The Hermitage: path to Ossian's Hall and the Black Linn Falls
activities.detail: Out and back on a level woodland path, 30 minutes.

activities.name: Dunkeld Cathedral and the riverside lawn
activities.detail: Free to enter; the ruined nave is open to the sky.

activities.name: Drive to St Andrews
activities.detail: About 90 minutes via Perth and Cupar.

activities.name: Check in at Ardgowan Hotel
activities.detail: One night, family room.

activities.name: West Sands beach
activities.detail: Firm sand at the embankment end; the long beach from Chariots of Fire.

dining.why_this_stop: A six-minute walk from the cathedral and right by the car, so lunch costs no extra driving.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Walk-in; Monday lunch is rarely full.
dining.backup_note: Switch if the Taybank kitchen is closed for a private event; Palmerston's serves lunch from 12:00.

dining.why_this_stop: Fourteen minutes' walk from the beach and seven back to the hotel, with a children's menu.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Book for Monday 17:45; the early sitting is quieter for children.
dining.backup_note: Use The Adamson on South Street if Forgan's cannot seat four; it opens for dinner at 17:00.

route.route_logic: Dunkeld is on the way south, so the waterfall and the cathedral break the drive before the 90-minute leg to Fife.
route.fallback_plan: In heavy rain skip the Hermitage path and see only Dunkeld Cathedral, then drive straight on.
route.walking_burden: 46 min on foot between stops (2.6 km of walking legs) plus 95 min on foot at stops, 141 min in total; no single walk over 30 min.
route.fare_basis_or_fuel_toll_parking_note: Fuel for the car plus two car parks (NTS at the Hermitage, Dunkeld pay-and-display) and overnight parking in St Andrews. No tolls.
route.service_or_driving_caveat: The M90 between Perth and Kinross is fast; the A91 through Cupar has 30 mph villages.

segments.journey_instruction: South on the A9 for 20 km; the Hermitage turn-off is signed just before Dunkeld.
segments.arrival_instruction: National Trust for Scotland car park at the start of the woodland path.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel plus the NTS car park charge of about GBP 4-5 (free for NTS members).
segments.fallback_note: If the car park is full, park in Dunkeld and walk the riverside path, about 25 minutes.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: A9 then A923 into Dunkeld
segments.journey_instruction: Back to the A9, cross the Tay bridge into Dunkeld and park in the Atholl Street car park.
segments.arrival_instruction: Walk down Cathedral Street to the cathedral gates.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel plus about GBP 2-3 for the Dunkeld pay-and-display.
segments.fallback_note: If Atholl Street is full, the Tay Terrace spaces are a minute further.

segments.journey_instruction: Back up Cathedral Street and left along Tay Terrace by the river.
segments.arrival_instruction: The Taybank is the white building on the corner by the bridge.
segments.fallback_note: Palmerston's on Atholl Street is the fallback, two minutes away.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: A9, M90, A91 via Cupar
segments.journey_instruction: Walk back to the car, take the A9 south to Perth, the M90 south to junction 8 and the A91 east through Cupar.
segments.arrival_instruction: The hotel is on Playfair Terrace off North Street; unload at the door and use the Argyle Street car park.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel for the leg plus overnight parking at the Argyle Street car park.
segments.fallback_note: If the M90 is slow, the A90 to Dundee and the Tay Road Bridge is a similar time.

segments.journey_instruction: Along North Street to the Bruce Embankment and down onto the beach.
segments.arrival_instruction: West Sands stretches north; the firm sand by the embankment is the easy end for children.
segments.fallback_note: In rain, the St Andrews Aquarium is next to the embankment.

segments.journey_instruction: Back up to The Scores and along Market Street.
segments.arrival_instruction: Forgan's is on Market Street, a converted shop with a long front window.
segments.fallback_note: The Adamson on South Street is the fallback.

segments.journey_instruction: North along Market Street and left onto North Street.
segments.arrival_instruction: Hotel entrance on Playfair Terrace.
segments.fallback_note: A short taxi if it is pouring.

days.contingency: If the A9 is closed, take the A822 via Crieff to Perth and skip the Hermitage; Dunkeld Cathedral still fits.

days.title: St Andrews morning, drive back, train home
days.focus: A last walk by the sea and the cathedral, the car back on time, and the 14:30 train.

activities.name: Check out and put the bags in the car
activities.detail: The car stays in the car park until 12:20.

activities.name: St Andrews Cathedral ruins and grounds
activities.detail: Free to walk the grounds.

activities.name: Market Street and South Street
activities.detail: Shops and a sit-down in a café.

activities.name: Drive to Edinburgh
activities.detail: About 85 minutes; refuel before the city.

activities.name: Return the car at Hertz, Edinburgh Waverley
activities.detail: Keep the fuel receipt and photograph the car.

activities.name: LNER train Edinburgh Waverley to London King's Cross
activities.detail: Arrives 18:51.

dining.rating_absence_reason: Hotel breakfast for residents; it has no separate public rating, and the hotel's guest score is on its accommodation card.
dining.why_this_stop: Included in the room rate and served before check-out.
dining.backup_note: A café two minutes away if breakfast is running late; opens 08:00.

dining.why_this_stop: A quick sit-down lunch seven minutes from the car, before the drive back.
dining.reservation_or_queue_note: Counter service; queue is short before 12:00.
dining.backup_note: Switch if the Cromars queue is out of the door; Tailend opens at 11:30.

route.route_logic: Everything in St Andrews is on foot from the hotel, so the car stays parked until the one drive back to Edinburgh.
route.fallback_plan: If the drive runs late, return the car first and take the next LNER service, 30 minutes later, on a flexible ticket.
route.walking_burden: 37 min on foot between stops (2.6 km of walking legs) plus 75 min on foot at stops, 112 min in total; the longest single walk is 15 min.
route.fare_basis_or_fuel_toll_parking_note: Fuel for the car including the top-up before return. No tolls. The hotel's car park fee is on the hotel card.
route.service_or_driving_caveat: Tuesday lunchtime traffic is light; the Queensferry Crossing can close to high-sided vehicles in wind but stays open to cars.

segments.journey_instruction: East along North Street to its end.
segments.arrival_instruction: The cathedral ruins are straight ahead behind the precinct wall.
segments.fallback_note: In rain, visit the cathedral museum only and walk back along South Street.

segments.journey_instruction: West along South Street, right up Church Street and along Market Street.
segments.arrival_instruction: Cromars is on the corner of Union Street; order at the counter.
segments.fallback_note: Tailend on Market Street is the fallback.

segments.journey_instruction: North up Union Street to North Street and left.
segments.arrival_instruction: Back to the hotel and the car.
segments.fallback_note: Taxi if it is raining hard.

segments.service_or_line: Hire car: A91, M90, Queensferry Crossing, A90
segments.journey_instruction: A91 west to the M90, south over the Queensferry Crossing and into Edinburgh on the A90; refuel at the Newbridge services before the city.
segments.arrival_instruction: Hertz return lane at the New Street car park by Waverley; keep the fuel receipt.
segments.fare_basis: Fuel for the leg, including the full-to-full top-up before return.
segments.fallback_note: If traffic on the A90 is bad, allow 30 minutes more and phone Hertz about a late return.

segments.journey_instruction: From the car park straight into the station concourse.
segments.arrival_instruction: Departure boards are on the main concourse; LNER leaves from the east end.
segments.fallback_note: The Market Street entrance if the car park link is closed.

days.contingency: If the car return runs past 14:15, take the 15:00 LNER service; an Advance ticket is train-specific, so book a flexible return if the drive worries you.

destination_experience_anchors.name: Blair Castle
destination_experience_anchors.why_it_matters: A white-harled castle the children can walk through room by room, with a walled garden outside.

destination_experience_anchors.name: Queen's View
destination_experience_anchors.why_it_matters: The classic view west along Loch Tummel, reached by a short paved path.

destination_experience_anchors.name: Pitlochry Dam
destination_experience_anchors.why_it_matters: A hydro dam with a salmon ladder you can watch through windows in October.

destination_experience_anchors.name: The Hermitage
